## Holds
- Check on branch `cl60`: `python3 -I -m pytest -q tests/test_cl60_last_message.py` → 11 passed.
- Breaks (`revert`): put `kit/hook.py`, `kit/hooks/kit_say_it_once.py`, `scripts/kit.py` back to main → 7 failed, 4 passed; restored, tree clean. The check can fail.
- Sampled bar (replay fixture): `scripts/closing_audit.py` on `tests/fixtures/cl60/before.jsonl` → 1 of 1 first closing longer than "·" (2,872 chars); on `after.jsonl` → 0 of 1; `test_hook_says_it_after_the_fixture_last_steps` asserts the line after all 3 last steps. Reproduced. Note the "after" fixture is written by the part, not a recorded session: it shows the hook fires, not that a part obeys.
- Live sign of the bug it fixes: this very review session (on main, without cl60) got "SAY IT ONCE: the owner typed this in your chat" on a turn that was a [SYSTEM NOTIFICATION] task notice: hole (2) of the post, still on main.
- Small: `scripts/closing_audit.py --help` ends in a FileNotFoundError traceback instead of the usage line (R3: say the error).
- **Not holding on the real thing:** the post's own `real_project` says BROKEN ON HARMONIZE (the update did not wire the PostToolUse line; `kit.setup=true` turned it off). The bar says both gaps are now fixed and tested in the kit's tests, but the Harmonize command was not rerun after the fix (the 07:44 hand-over says the same). Not checked by me: no Harmonize clone in this session, and a review does not attach repos.

- **Update 07:57 (orchestrator 4's new real_project run):** install OK, resume exit 0, rules-check as on unchanged Harmonize — a no-regression run. It does not run this step's own probe (the say-it-once hook after `kit.py done` on the copy, and the copy's PostToolUse line), which is what said BROKEN. Still open.

## Goal
Train `takeover`: a part's end costs the owner nothing to read (one "·", the post holds the rest). The measure (a hook line after the last steps) is a means; the real measure is the share of real part turn ends that open with "·" — before: 11 of 13. That needs live parts on this kit; until then the bar is a fixture. With CL61 also BROKEN ON HARMONIZE, two steps of this train say "a kit fix reaches a project on update" and both failed on the one real project: that is the train's open question, not either step's.

## Verdict
